blockingLoop.evidence: Asked again 'Is it a conventional or an inverter microwave' after the customer said 'no idea what an inverter is'; later asked whether it was on low power or grill mode despite H98 appearing on microwave mode

rationale: The assistant correctly interpreted H98 as a magnetron/inverter power fault and repeated the safety warning not to open the case. It then ignored the customer's repeated answers (model given three times, 'don't know what an inverter is'), kept asking about inverter type, power level and grill mode, and never clearly advised getting a Panasonic or engineer quote. The customer's direct question on repair value got only a generic answer, with no concrete recommendation to get a quote for the magnetron or inverter fault.
